name: RC JAR registered legal entities (JuridinisAsmuo)
note: No API key. Keyset pagination via the _page.next cursor (append &page('<cursor>')). Identity keyed on ja_kodas (9-digit). Resolve forma/statusas _id refs against formos_statusai/Forma and /Statusas.

name: RC JAR addresses (Buveine)
note: Addresses linked to a company by juridinis_asmuo. No key.

name: RC JAR balance sheets (BalansoAtaskaita)
note: Open balance-sheet line items (EUR), linked by juridinis_asmuo._id. Aggregate per company + period. No key.

name: RC JAR profit & loss (PelnoAtaskaita)
note: Open P&L line items (EUR). Same shape as the balance-sheet model. No key.
